about: The tract for votive Masses of the Seven Sorrows of the Blessed Virgin Mary after Septuagesima in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Holy Mary, Queen of heaven and Lady of the world, stood in sorrow beside the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. O all you who pass along the road, pay attention and see whether there is sorrow like my sorrow.

ex.w016: The chant moves from describing Mary to the first-person appeal of Lamentations 1:12.
ex.w026: The command asks the passersby to consider whether there is comparable sorrow. This is an inquiry, not a condition restricting the command.
